TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: TraceabilityReport counts requirements, use cases, modules, functions, LOG evidence, score, and gaps.
Strict enforcement fails untraced requirements or functions while advisory mode reports gaps without blocking migration.
Synapse module-family defaults map modules to UC/NFR product intent and functions inherit module traces unless direct function LINKS override them.
traceability_report MCP output persists compact docs/traceability-index.xml with capped samples and returns full scoped module/requirement matrices through split render helpers.
